title: Tuna Tagine Tagine
description: A flavorful Middle Eastern-inspired dish featuring tuna and zesty tagine sauce. Serve over couscous for a hearty meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tuna steaks and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tagine sauce and ground cumin.
Pour the sauce over the tuna and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly.
Season with salt and cayenne pepper (if using).
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley and a side of couscous.
